notes: Parallel male/receiving stud-system axes transmit the build direction; fit and collision remain separate.
An input/output axial separation is an exact nonzero multiple of 8 LDU; 24 LDU equals one brick.
At least two distinct mates were checked under the same rigid pose; this is not inferred from a part merely having several studs.

diagnostics.message: Some stud-system features lack a source-backed exact unit axis or established position; no rounding or guessed pattern was applied to them.

contributions.reason: 18 actual rigid connection observations; no invented load capacity.
Multiple actual edges provide a ranking signal; geometry and load path remain separate evidence.

missingFactors: Material strength, friction forces and physical build verification
